The '''Feraleech system''' was located in the [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the encryption technique known as the [[Feraleechi Onetime Loop]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|264|Feraleechi Onetime Loop}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Feraleechi Onetime Loop]]|system=Feraleech [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Feraleech [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-13.<ref name="TEA" />
